Hi Irene — thanks for sending this over. We appreciate the clear draft. Emily and I did a quick pass and attached our redlines (redlines_fieldstone_v1.pdf). High-level notes: 

1) Numbers: the token savings callout on page 2 says "~45% lower token cost" — our internal calc shows 32% for the pilot period you reference. Please correct the percentage and add a parenthetical note that this reflects a 60-day pilot.
2) Scope: the draft uses the word "production" in a few places. Fieldstone is currently in a pilot; please change wording to "pilot" or "production pilot" where appropriate.
3) Quote: the current quote attribution is good, but please remove the line that references our internal roadmap. We prefer to keep quotes focused on outcomes. Proposed replacement in the PDF.
4) Logo & branding: we need to confirm with PR. For the moment please leave the logo out of any public preview.

We're attaching annotated redlines. We can turn this around quickly once you incorporate the corrections. Also — will Redwood keep the customer data examples in the appendix anonymized? We need confirmation on that.

Thanks,
Rachel Lang
